Business Case Summary: Agentic AI in IT Delivery (DEM-2026-0001)

Executive Summary  
This project aims to explore and implement agentic AI technologies to enhance IT delivery processes. The approach focuses on leveraging AI to improve efficiency and decision-making within the infrastructure domain.

Business Value  
By integrating agentic AI, IT delivery can achieve faster deployment cycles and reduced operational costs. Improved automation will increase reliability and support scalability in infrastructure services.

Risk Mitigation  
Potential medium-level risks include implementation challenges and technology adoption barriers. Mitigation involves phased deployment, continuous monitoring, and staff training to ensure smooth integration and acceptance.
